stories.headline: Vietnam is looking to restrict social media for kids; here are the growing number of other countries doing the same
stories.dek: Australia was the first country to issue a ban in late 2025, aiming to reduce the pressures and risks that young users may face on social media, including cyberbullying, social media addiction, and exposure to predators.

stories.headline: One of NASA’s Most Important Deep Space Observatories Hit by Spanish Wildfires
stories.dek: Flames burned through the Deep Space Communications Complex near Madrid, but NASA has been unable to assess the damage as a wildfire emergency grips the region.

stories.headline: Why Cognition bought Poke: AI personality is becoming a competitive advantage
stories.dek: The acquisition brings Poke’s conversational style and interaction model to Cognition’s coding agent Devin, reflecting a growing belief that how AI assistants interact with users is as important as the models powering them.

stories.headline: US accuses American of allegedly wiping his phone using a ‘duress’ password during border search
stories.dek: A U.S. citizen has asked a court to throw out the government's claim that he gave over a passcode to border authorities that wiped his phone's data, opening up fresh questions about a person's constitutional rights at the U.S. border.

stories.headline: Rivian sues the US government for ‘full refund’ of Trump tariffs
stories.dek: The automaker joins a long line of companies seeking such refunds. In April, Rivian CFO Claire McDonough said she expected the company stood to reap a refund in the "tens of millions of dollars."
